candidate_identity: 40nm Ti0.4Sb2Te3 conventional 1T1R current-read reference, binary planes; architecture/model proposal rather than reproduced measured macro

sources.use: IBM doped GST 14nm; current waveforms and verify bias are compatible within this source, but endpoint magnitudes in ADC counts need conversion before a resistor frontend can use them.
Voltage-sum topology is not the new identity; complete access excluded from new computation.
Ge-rich GST resistance/drift and voltage pulses; actual program current and pulse endpoint dynamics missing. Do not combine its R with IBM current waveforms.
Row-wise programming/verify and variability; 512 lanes not installed for free.

sources.title: A Phase Change Memory Chip Based on TiSbTe Alloy in 40-nm Standard CMOS Technology
limitations: Measured read voltage and low-bias I-V not stated in this paper.
Current-pulse width and edges not fully separated; do not add guessed tail/cooling.
Resistance distributions are not a paired R_on/R_off joint distribution; statement minimal ratio >10 cannot be inferred by dividing opposite distribution extrema.
SET speed includes influence of original peripheral parasitics; transfer is an external characterized current-pulse primitive, not intrinsic material switching prediction.
No finite endpoint retry success distribution or local drift horizon is reported.

CRITICAL: prose SET distribution appears to describe DC_SET rather than PULSE_SET in Fig6; do not pair DC_SET resistance with 100ns pulse programming. Accepted single-cell endpoint windows/verify may define a finite successful service, but yield remains unknown.

visual_review.finding: Fig6 distinguishes DC_SET blue from PULSE_SET red. Text SET logR3.7-4.5 corresponds visually to DC_SET, not the pulse-programmed distribution. PULSE_SET extends approximately logR4.0-5.2 and overlaps the RST distribution lower range. These visual ranges are approximate, not digitized data. No global fixed threshold yield claim is justified.

physical_evidence: PCM-01 RESET/SET/verify evidence, retained as one alternative package
PCM-05 Ge-rich GST electrical states/drift, retained separately
PCM-06 row programming topology and endpoint variability
architecture_choices: 32 current drivers and 22.4mA return rating belong to old design, not imposed on new candidate
background_output: old PCM voltage-sum output only; no new calculation dependency

upstream_candidate.critical_issue: read-resistance-based automatic access width is not a proof of 0.5mA thermal-write ability; generic RRAM pulse counter is not PCM full-cover program.

p1_exit_requirements: Select same-source electrical/pulse package and engineering low-read bias qualification.
Dimension/access-check the 0.5mA path and size column-return current for actual program lanes.
Resolve analog sum versus binary sense: measured endpoint spread must not silently become exact analog popcount.
Reference must include endpoint verification, real bit-plane resources, and finite failure result.
Hold waveform timings fixed unless use a documented protocol comparison; no fabricated retry probabilities.
Use pulse-programmed resistance states; resolve Fig6 text/legend mismatch and global state-distribution overlap via explicitly successful endpoint conditions, no invented yield.

scenario_candidate.interpretation: finite operating-policy scenarios, not measured silicon corners
fixed: same low-read bias and endpoint acceptance
temperature fixed until material evidence supports variation
scenario_candidate.main_family: Source demonstrates flat final-state response for RESET width 10-200ns and SET width 100-2000ns; use three documented duration policies only after waveform inclusion/thermal and service checks. Read rate may legitimately remain equal.
scenario_candidate.second_family: Endpoint R sensitivity must be separate or qualified with measured joint support; do not pick independent favorable extrema.
